en: A color postcard composed of two landscape views. The upper image shows a European riverside cityscape with historic buildings along the water, a sightseeing boat on the river, and a prominent twin‑towered Romanesque church with flags atop each tower. Swiss flags hang from a building on the left. The lower image shows distant snow‑covered mountains under a blue sky, with the green spire of a church in the foreground. The overall style suggests a mid‑20th‑century tourist postcard.
